section_summary: Pages 400-406 continue SCAP's Sapporo-region register of Hokkaido ship radio stations, recording vessels, registry ports, tonnage, operating agencies, call signs, frequency changes, and emission types. Page 407 begins Part IV, an alphabetical call-sign directory, and pages 408-479 match call signs from JAAA through JQLX with SCAP registration numbers and ship names. The alphabetical directory continues beyond this section.

subfiles.title: Sapporo Region—Hokkaido Ship Radio Station Register (continuation)
subfiles.about: Continuation of a regional register identifying Hokkaido vessels and their radio-station particulars.
subfiles.summary: These pages continue the Sapporo-region portion of a SCAP ship radio register, covering registration numbers 80S031 through 80S135. Entries give vessel name, registry port, tonnage, operating agency, call sign, frequency additions or deletions, and emission or vessel type. The listed craft include fishing boats, commercial vessels, guard boats, and government railway ferries operating from ports around Hokkaido.

subfiles.title: Part IV: Alphabetical Call Sign List of Ship Radio Stations
subfiles.about: An alphabetical directory matching maritime radio call signs to SCAP registration numbers and vessel names.
subfiles.summary: Page 407 is the title page for Part IV, the alphabetical call-sign list of ship radio stations. Pages 408-479 arrange entries by call sign, beginning with JAAA and reaching JQLX, with each entry supplying a SCAP registration number and ship name. The directory encompasses a large variety of Japanese commercial, fishing, patrol, and government vessels and continues beyond the final page supplied here.
